name: Bharatanatyam
medium: Dance, expressive gestures and Carnatic music
description: One of India's oldest classical dance forms, known for precise movements, expressive storytelling, intricate footwork and traditional costumes.

name: Kathak
description: A classical dance form recognised for rapid spins, rhythmic footwork, expressive gestures and storytelling traditions.

name: Kathakali
description: A dramatic dance-theatre tradition featuring colourful makeup, elaborate costumes, facial expressions and stories from Indian epics.

name: Kuchipudi
description: A classical dance tradition combining graceful movements, dramatic expression and rhythmic sequences.

name: Odissi
description: Known for fluid movements, sculptural poses and expressive storytelling inspired by Odisha's temple traditions.

name: Manipuri Dance
description: A graceful classical dance tradition often associated with Vaishnavite themes and the stories of Radha and Krishna.

name: Mohiniyattam
description: A graceful classical dance form characterised by gentle movements, flowing costumes and expressive storytelling.

name: Sattriya
description: A classical dance tradition developed in Assam's monasteries, combining devotional storytelling, music and movement.

name: Bhangra
medium: Energetic dance, dhol and folk music
description: A lively Punjabi folk dance traditionally associated with harvest celebrations and performed to energetic dhol rhythms.

name: Giddha
medium: Women's folk dance, boliyan and clapping
description: A traditional Punjabi women's folk dance featuring expressive movements, rhythmic clapping and witty folk verses called boliyan.

name: Garba
description: A popular circular folk dance performed during Navratri, celebrating devotion through colourful costumes and rhythmic movements.

name: Dandiya Raas
description: A festive group dance in which participants perform coordinated steps while striking decorated wooden sticks.

name: Bihu Dance
medium: Dance, dhol, pepa and traditional music
description: An energetic Assamese folk dance performed during Bihu celebrations, especially the spring festival of Rongali Bihu.

name: Ghoomar
description: A traditional Rajasthani dance known for graceful circular movements and colourful flowing ghagras.

name: Lavani
description: A lively performance tradition combining expressive singing, rhythmic dance and the beats of the dholki.

name: Madhubani Painting
medium: Natural and synthetic colours on paper, cloth and walls
description: A distinctive painting tradition featuring intricate patterns, symbolic motifs, nature and mythological stories.

name: Warli Painting
description: A tribal art tradition using simple geometric forms to depict village life, farming, celebrations and nature.

name: Pattachitra
description: A traditional painting style known for detailed mythological themes, decorative borders and vivid colours.

name: Kalamkari
description: A textile art tradition using a pen or printing blocks to create detailed designs inspired by epics, nature and folklore.

name: Phad Painting
description: A traditional scroll-painting style depicting stories of folk deities and heroes, historically presented by travelling storytellers.

name: Thanjavur Painting
medium: Wooden panels, gold foil and vibrant pigments
description: A classical South Indian painting tradition recognised for devotional subjects, rich colours and decorative gold foil.

name: Pashmina Weaving
medium: Fine cashmere wool weaving and embroidery
description: A renowned textile craft producing exceptionally fine shawls from the soft undercoat of Himalayan goats.

name: Jaipur Blue Pottery
description: A distinctive craft recognised for its blue and turquoise designs, floral motifs and glazed decorative objects.

name: Channapatna Toys
medium: Wood carving, turning and natural lac colouring
description: Traditional wooden toys and decorative objects made using turning techniques and colourful lacquer finishes.

name: Dokra Metal Craft
description: An ancient metal-casting craft that creates distinctive brass and bronze figures using the lost-wax technique.

name: Kathputli
description: A traditional Rajasthani puppet theatre in which colourful wooden puppets bring folk tales and heroic stories to life.

name: Yakshagana
medium: Dance-drama, music, elaborate costumes and dialogue
description: A vibrant theatre tradition combining dance, music, dialogue and elaborate costumes to narrate stories from Indian epics.

name: Chhau Dance
medium: Martial movements, masks and dramatic storytelling
description: A powerful dance tradition combining martial arts, acrobatics and dramatic storytelling. Major styles include Purulia, Seraikella and Mayurbhanj Chhau.

name: Carnatic Music
medium: Raga, tala, vocal and instrumental music
description: A major Indian classical music tradition based on intricate melodic frameworks, rhythmic structures and devotional compositions.

name: Hindustani Classical Music
description: A North Indian classical music tradition featuring ragas, improvisation and forms such as khayal, dhrupad and thumri.
